text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing fatigue, malaise, and unintentional weight loss; to begin our assessment, have you noticed any fevers, night sweats, or changes in your appetite over the past few weeks?

speaker: Patient
text: 71-year-old male. The patient complains of fatigue and malaise over the last few months. He also reports an unintentional weight loss of 18.1 kg over the past 6 months. He does not recall any changes in diet or exercise routines that could explain the weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is a significant amount of weight loss. Given your age and these "B symptoms" (fatigue, malaise, weight loss), have you experienced any persistent cough, shortness of breath, or changes in your skin or lymph nodes?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue and malaise. I also have Significant unintentional weight loss, No change in diet or exercise.

speaker: Doctor
text:
I have noted your significant weight loss of over 18 kg. To narrow the differential, have you noticed any swollen lymph nodes in your neck, armpits, or groin, or any lumps under your skin?
